name: CosmosCraft Direct Order for WooCommerce
author: Himanshu Sindhal

sections.description:
CosmosCraft Direct Order for WooCommerce is a lightweight, production-ready WordPress plugin that integrates a customizable WhatsApp order button into your WooCommerce product pages. When clicked, it redirects users to WhatsApp with a pre-filled, dynamic message containing the product name, price, and URL.

Features

  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce “Add to Cart” area.
  • Dynamic auto-fill message with placeholders {product_name}, {product_price}, {product_url}.
  • Customizable button text and WhatsApp number.
  • Mobile optimized: Optional sticky button for mobile devices.
  • Shortcode support [ccdow_whatsapp_order_button].
  • Lightweight and performant: No jQuery dependency, minimal CSS.
  • Secure and strictly follows WordPress coding standards.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/cosmoscraft-direct-order-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > WhatsApp Order.
  4. Enter your WhatsApp number (with country code) and customize the message template.
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin depends on WooCommerce to fetch product details and hook into the product pages.

Can I use it on pages other than product pages?

You can use the shortcode [ccdow_whatsapp_order_button product_id="123"] to show the button on other pages, providing the product ID.
